## PR 620

**Signed calls from the ERP to the shop — top products and customers on click (CN-028; 25 Oct 2026)**

**বাংলায়:** ERP-তে "Top products" বা "Customers" চাপলে ERP তখনই দোকানের কাছে তালিকা চায়, দোকানের নিজের গোপন কোডে সই করা থাকলে তবেই উত্তর; দোকান নিজে কিছু পাঠায় না; চাবি ও সংযোগ পাতায় সুইচ (বন্ধ) আর ঠিকানা

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-30
  - Build status row: signed calls from the ERP to the shop (CN-028, docs/erp/site-changes-v6.md §2.7; no migration): `GET /erp-api/top-products?from&to&limit` (Sales by SKU from `@extas/metrics` `salesBySku`: pieces, net sales, profit over the cost snapshot) and `GET /erp-api/customers?page&pageSize&search` (`@extas/customers` `erpCustomerPage`: one row per person who ordered, total spent = Sales), answered live and never pushed. Signed `X-Extas-Signature` over `METHOD\nPATH?QUERY\nTIMESTAMP`, constant-time, refused beyond `erp.siteApi.maxAgeSeconds` (300); the store is the one whose own secret verifies (CN-029 §16: the new optional third ERP key `signingSecret`, else the webhook secret; v6 stores only; a shared secret refused). Today the key and the card are the mother store's, on Keys & connections; each store's own key and card come with its ERP link page (PR 619). Off per store (`erp.siteApi.enabled`, registry v65) until switched on on the new "The ERP asks the shop" card on `/admin/integrations` (`vault.write`), which shows the base URL, the latest verified calls and the refused calls summed. qa-gate (30 Oct): a call refused from the request alone (path, method, no or a malformed signature) reads no database, setting or vault; refusals are only counted (one SecurityEvent `erp.site-call.refused` summary per `erp.siteApi.refusedLogMinutes`), after `erp.siteApi.refusedPerMinute` refused calls a minute further unverified calls get 429 without a store lookup, and only a verified caller's call gets its own `erp.site-call` row (no customer data); the search length is `erp.siteApi.searchMaxChars`; the query is signed percent-encoded. The preview gate lets only these two GET paths through, matched on the raw request target case for case, as are the ERP and WhatsApp webhook exemptions (gate v5; CI runs the live gate checks on a pinned Caddy 2.10.2). After launch
  - GitHub pull request #59, 30 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #57, 30 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** **Signed calls from the ERP to the shop** (CN-028). `GET /erp-api/top-products` and `GET /erp-api/customers`, signed like the webhooks (`X-Extas-Signature` over `METHOD\nPATH?QUERY\nTIMESTAMP`, constant-time check, refused when older than 5 minutes), opened on the staging password gate for that path only, every call logged, customer data returned live and never pushed. The admin shows the base URL to put into the ERP. After launch.
- **Filed under:** [CN-028 additions — Retail and the ERP supplier model (25 Oct 2026)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#cn-028-additions--retail-and-the-erp-supplier-model-25-oct-2026)
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `GET /erp-api/top-products?from&to&limit`, `@extas/metrics`, `GET /erp-api/customers?page&pageSize&search`, `@extas/customers`
  - Routes: `/admin/integrations`
  - Settings and named keys: `erp.siteApi.maxAgeSeconds`, `erp.siteApi.enabled`, `vault.write`, `erp.siteApi.refusedLogMinutes`, `erp.siteApi.refusedPerMinute`, `erp.siteApi.searchMaxChars`
  - Names in the code: `salesBySku`, `erpCustomerPage`, `X-Extas-Signature`, `METHOD\nPATH?QUERY\nTIMESTAMP`, `signingSecret`, `erp.site-call.refused`, `erp.site-call`
  - Tests: CI runs the live gate checks on a pinned Caddy 2.10.2)
- **Owning agent:** Prohori
